The athlete answered Holt's question about training history with "3 years". This is a follow-up to a full program build. Experience is lifting and running; "3 years" doesn't say which, and the engine needs experience fields. Mode is a full program, so the reply should be a patch carrying what was given. Since the context is a general training history with no specific lifting or running split, I'll set experienceLifting as the most natural reading only if it's clearly about lifting. It isn't specified, so I should not guess. Best to return a patch with no fields guessed, and a short confirmation asking which they meant, or simply acknowledge. A patch with empty fields is not useful, so I'll return answer with a question instead.

{"route": "answer", "say": "Three years is a solid base to build on. Is that lifting, running, or both? Tell me which, and we'll set the starting point from there."}
